a11y.apg: No APG pattern: it is a <div> that joins adjacent buttons into one capsule. It adds no roving tabindex on purpose — the buttons stay independent tab stops, which is what a group of separate actions should be. A single choice among options is SegmentedControl, which IS a radiogroup.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the group. Falls back to the i18n string, but a real name beats a generic one.

props.name: children
props.description: Buttons of the same kind. Mixing controls here breaks the promise of a group.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Stacks the buttons instead of lining them up. Visual only — it changes no order, no semantics and no keyboard — so it resolves in the CSS layer and costs no observer.
